name: nvfp4-sm120-mma-k64
what: Model replay of GemmAccumulator<K> (K a multiple of 64): tc_dot64_0, then (K/64 - 1) x tc_dot64 chained in ascending k; no cast at K=64 on blackwell_sm120_nvf4_m16n8k64: the FP32 accumulator word after every tc_dot64 step, from a zero accumulator.  Produced by verity.ml.tc.models.BlockScaledAlignAdd.step on the laptop (lane fp4-proof, 2026-09-22) -- NOT a hardware capture; the instruction's pin is the model's evidence (verity.ml.tc.instructions.INSTRUCTIONS[instruction].evidence).

generator.recipe: random.Random(seed): per E2M1 code u = rng.random(): u < 0.10 -> +-0 (0x0/0x8); u < 0.25 -> +-0.5 (the subnormal, 0x1/0x9); u < 0.30 -> +-6 (0x7/0xF); else a uniformly random nibble; per UE4M3 scale byte v = rng.random(): v < 0.05 -> 0x00 (a zero scale); v < 0.15 -> a subnormal field (exponent 0, mantissa 1..7); v < 0.20 -> exponent 15 with mantissa 0..6 (the largest scales, never the NaN code 0x7F); else a uniformly random byte in [0x08, 0x7F); codes then scales for A, then for B; the accumulator starts at +0.0 (0x00000000)

operand_format: a = k E2M1 nibbles (0x0..0xF) then k/16 UE4M3 scale bytes (0x..), likewise b; a[i] and b[i] pair by index, ascending k; scale j covers codes 16j..16j+15
